subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate segment to substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

__You have tears__, prepare to shed them now.
solution: The correct answer is **Option 1)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"If you have tears"** is used to indicate a conditional situation where someone is expected to have tears. (यदि आपके पास आँसू हैं) • **Example:** If you have tears, let them flow now. • **"Prepare to shed them now"** means to get ready to cry or show emotions immediately. (अब उन्हें बहाने के लिए तैयार हो जाओ) • **Example:** The heartbreaking news made everyone prepare to shed their tears. Hence, we can infer that the correct phrase is **"If you have tears"** as it logically fits the context of the sentence. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Yet you have tears** (फिर भी आपके पास आँसू हैं): This suggests a contrast or contradiction that is not suitable for the given sentence. • **Example:** Yet you have tears, even though you said you wouldn't cry. • **Until you have tears** (जब तक आपके पास आँसू नहीं आते): This indicates a time condition that doesn't fit the context. • **Example:** Wait here until you have tears in your eyes. • **Unless you have tears** (जब तक आपके पास आँसू नहीं हैं): This implies a condition that must not be met, which is incorrect for the given sentence. • **Example:** You won't understand the pain unless you have tears in your eyes. 3c7:Tb4f, The correct answer is** Option 4)**
